methods.inclusion: six complete measurement windows; 10mm repeat2 retains aborted status (sensor time rollback during high return)
methods.repeat: aligned identical planned id_* ticks, all 1960 measurement rows; optional mean-offset removal is diagnostic only
methods.limitations: No no-excitation reference at matched X; spatial and history effects confounded; 2 repeats per depth; no independent validation.
